content: समुत्पत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To jump or spring up, rise, ascend; किरातसैन्यादुरुचापनोदिताः समं समुत्पेतुरुपात्तरंहसः <ls>Ki. 14. 45</ls>. .²2 To arise, spring from. .²3 To rush out of, gush out. .²4 To rush or break forth. .²5 To attack, assail. .²6 To depart, disappear; समुत्पतिततेजाः (भवति हि पापं कृत्वा) <ls>Pt. 1. 197</ls>.
